description:
A worked example of an extension: a jar with a manifest
        (META-INF/mindconnect/extension.json) that brings a tool (demo_dice), an
        agent (dungeon-master, seeded from initial-data), a runtime feature that
        decorates a core port and keeps a store of its own, and two screens — an
        adventure the agent runs as game master (/admin/demo-dungeon) and the dice
        statistics (/admin/demo-dungeon/stats). Not a dependency of any app — drop
        the jar on the admin UI's classpath (PropertiesLauncher, loader.path) and it
        appears under Install → Extensions.
